papers.title: FROM FACE-TO-FACE TO ONLINE EDUCATIONAL ROBOTICS COMPETITIONS: A LONGITUDINAL STUDY OF PARTICIPATION AND LEARNING OUTCOMES
papers.summary: This study examines the evolution of the Aegean Robotics Competition (ARC) from a face-to-face educational robotics event to an online competition format. Using a longitudinal case study approach, participation records and questionnaire data collected from students, coaches, organizers, and judges across five competition cycles (2017–2022) were analyzed. papers.summary: Agricultural robotics is becoming increasingly relevant for executing arduous tasks where human labour is scarce. papers.summary: Introduction Which robot would you trust to guide you through a breathing exercise, a cute cartoon-like humanoid, a soft animal companion, a clinical mechanical device, or a serene meditative figure? This study proposes a Context-Aware Road Safety Assessment (CARSA) framework based on semantic scene understanding and multidisciplinary expert evaluation.
